MiniMax has launched M3.1 Flash, claiming 'a generational leap' in agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity, with open weights due October 23. Notably, MiniMax says 'Space Bunny' - the anonymous model that processed more than 200 trillion tokens on public platforms - was an early version of M3.1 Flash, giving the launch an unusual public track record.
